source_policy: 保原两移花50%、梅吸血进击低于50%/伤害50%/最多2000、穷途末路反弹双倍及反弹无效涵盖穷途末路。下列其他系数/概率/时序/同动作上限是项目采用；三潭和弦增幅精确比例未由官网给出。

bindings.name: 移花接木
bindings.eligible_root_override: attack_martial_skill only; explicit63794八转published restriction, not basicnormal

common.source_damage: actual hostile HP loss, exclude shields/self-cost/overkill
common.post_hit_order: finish source hit lethal interception/death first; only living recipient performs reflect/heal; reflection cannot resurrect source
common.heal_block: all healing obeys HP recovery block; blocked amount discarded, no catchup or source damage rollback
common.rng_order: eligible defender passives by stable qigongID after original HP-loss snapshot, then attacker lifesteal; require recipient still alive
common.duplicate_or_replayed_damage: original callback result reused, no second draw/heal/reflect

received_reflect.target: original attacker if still alive/hostile/same active scene
received_reflect.phase: instant derived reflection; no weapon hit/accuracy/crit/ordinary defense again; explicit reflected-damage reduction and hostile shield apply once

reflect_double.same_reflect_event: modify existing bounded reflect amount once, then final cap owner attack*2; no second extra hit

successful_hit_lifesteal.eligible: normal or attack martial root primary actual HP loss, once per action; no lifesteal from each secondary or derived hit
successful_hit_lifesteal.chance: explicit100percent when qualified; do not fabricate extra random chance absent source
successful_hit_lifesteal.after_reflection_attacker_death: no heal resurrection; committed original damage remains

received_lifedrain.damage_pipeline: derived reflection-like life-drain, obey reflected-damage reduction/shield once, no ordinary defense/crit/attack callbacks
received_lifedrain.hp_restored: actual original attackerHP lost to this drain only, not requested raw damage; HP healing block can deny restore while drain still harms attacker

received_reflect_and_chords.chord_formula: base chord bonus * (10000+50*effective_grade)/10000 floor; e.g1000base at20 ->1100bp
received_reflect_and_chords.applies_to: exact active triad/seventh/ninth own effect, not all stats three times
received_reflect_and_chords.temporary_effective_zero: remove this added contribution; chord baseline remains
received_reflect_and_chords.composition_owner: 乐师和弦联动气功.v1.json chord_composition; base-only Santan extra added once, not entire Yueyang/Luanfengtotal

low_hp_received_heal.threshold: HP strictly below50percent after root received damage, still alive

reflected_damage_reduction.stacking: named profile once, never add same instance twice

persistence: callback receipts/derived damage roots and per-action passive-consumed flags captured with action; HP result and random consumption in same transaction. Ordinary save waits all derived results. No regeneration by re-reading old callback after load.
source_condition_override: 剑移花触发武功限定来自63794八转正文；谭同名无此指定，不跨职业复制。
